headline: Tetris - the game from a Soviet computer lab
title: The Story of Tetris | A Soviet Engineer's Puzzle Game | Classic Games
video_script: Tetris was created by Alexey Pajitnov, a Soviet software engineer, in the mid nineteen eighties. He made it in his spare time while working at the Dorodnitsyn Computing Center in Moscow. In the game, falling pieces made of four connected blocks must fill a horizontal line, and when a line is complete it disappears. Copies on floppy disks spread freely around Moscow before reaching Eastern Europe. Which classic puzzle game do you love? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Fill a line to clear it
